title: Patriots OC Josh McDaniels: I have to do a better job of limiting Seahawks opportunities

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots OC Josh McDaniels: I have to do a better job of limiting Seahawks opportunities
sources.description: The Patriots will kick off the 2026 season against the same team that dashed their hopes of winning the Super Bowl and that will lead to some reflection on what went wrong against the Seahawks at Levi's Stadium in February.
